beats.text: Nigeria applies 13 kilograms of fertilizer per hectare of arable land.
The USA applies 128 kilograms per hectare, while India uses 214.
Climbing higher: Brazil uses 397 kilograms, Egypt has 598, Ireland 987, and Malaysia 1,869.
At the top, Kuwait uses 2,488 kilograms per hectare, 19 times what the USA uses.
This counts nitrogenous, potash, and phosphate plant nutrients used per unit of arable land.
How heavily fertilized is the cropland in your country?
